title: Slow Drip
html:
Quest Giver: Javier Waldez the Java Distributor

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Discover why Javier's business has become so slow.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Javier Waldez the Java Distributor

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Passionate Percolation

Zone: Balzack's Burrow

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Discover why Javier's business has become so slow.

Offer:

I have the best coffee in the whole Kingdom. You know how I know, because it is the only coffee that has been approved by the TDA! Yes I know what you're thinking, aren't they the ones who temporarily approved FizzStar Fizzing Fizz Drink? I would have to say 'Yes that's the same Townston Drink Association.' But, they are now under new management now, the Kings Chefs Dishwasher.

Now that you know about my amazingly great coffee and understand that there is no better coffee in the whole Kingdom, I want you to find out why the monsters dancing in Balzack's are not buying from me anymore?

Why dont you do me a favor and go in there and dig through the trash to see if you can discover what those Monsters are really drinking.

Bring some mystery monster drink evidence back to me, Javier the best Barista in Balzacks Base Camp, so I can see it for myself!

Turn-in:

Karlbucks!?! I swear everytime I blink they are opening a new in-dungeon cart. Oh this gets me really steamed, I know there is some evil organization behind those coffee pushers. We need to get to the bottom of this right away!

Objectives:

  • Evidence ×1

Client level range: 55–100
